confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Hobart and comparable Australian cities, not from inspected listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than hostel and hotel anchors, which vary more with season and events. The FX observation came from search-result snippets; I did not open the RBA page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Australian cities with similar pricing, such as Adelaide and Brisbane, adjusted for Hobart's typically lower accommodation prices and its July winter (low-season) pricing.
